turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
reaching out. Orders without custom or pre-order items are typically fulfilled within 2–3 business days. Once the physical items ship, you’ll receive a tracking link by email or SMS, depending on your notification preference. Tracking can take up to 3 business days to update after shipment, excluding weekends and holidays.

Custom items, pre-orders, and phone cases can take longer. Pre-orders typically ship within 4–6 weeks, and promotional or holiday periods may also extend processing times 💖

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Once your order ships, delivery typically takes:

Domestic Priority Shipping: 2–7 business days from the shipment date
U.S. Express Delivery: 1–2 business days from the shipment date
International delivery: 15–20 business days from the shipment date

These timeframes are separate from processing and aren’t guaranteed. Weather, holidays, and customs clearance can add time. You’ll receive a tracking link by email or SMS once the physical items ship 💖

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
I understand you need it sooner. Since the order has already been placed, we can’t upgrade it to Express after checkout.

For future U.S. orders, Express Delivery can be selected at checkout and typically takes 1–2 business days from the shipment date. Priority Shipping typically takes 2–7 business days from shipment. These timeframes don’t include processing and aren’t guaranteed 💖

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: Please send your order number, the email used at checkout, or the phone number on the order. I’ll check whether the physical items have shipped and whether the carrier has recorded a scan. If your order includes a custom item, pre-order, or phone case, tracking may take longer to appear 💖

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for getting in touch. Once your physical items ship, your tracking link is sent by email or SMS, based on your notification preference. You can also check your order here: https://account.evryjewels.com/?lang=en

If you don’t see it, please check your spam or junk folder. If it’s still missing, send your order number, checkout email, or phone number so I can check the shipment for you 💖

turns.replyTail:
Thanks for letting us know. Please check around your delivery location, including porches, backyards, side doors, and with neighbours who may have accepted it.

To check the delivery details and next steps, please send your order number, the email used at checkout, or the phone number on the order 💖
